name: Rainbow
description_en: Rainbow by Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise combines persistent group conversations, files and meetings with business telephony services. Its Bubbles organize project communication. Choosing it requires matching collaboration access to the relevant Hybrid or Voice subscription and, where applicable, an existing telephone system or a separately specified private deployment.
description_zh: Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise 的 Rainbow 结合持续群组对话、文件、会议及企业电话服务，用 Bubble 组织项目沟通。选型需把协作访问与相应 Hybrid 或 Voice 订阅对应；如涉及现有电话系统或单独约定的私有部署，还要核对对应条件。

core_features.explanation_en: Bring messages, shared files and conferences into one group conversation.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在同一群组对话中汇集消息、共享文件及会议。

core_features.explanation_en: An owner controls link scope; an organizer can admit waiting guests.
core_features.explanation_zh: 所有者控制链接范围，组织者可批准等候来宾。

core_features.explanation_en: Hybrid PBX control and Voice cloud telephony are distinct service paths.
core_features.explanation_zh: Hybrid PBX 控制与 Voice 云电话是不同服务路径。

en: Evaluate a synthetic service case from Bubble messages and file sharing to a controlled customer call and retained decision copy.
zh: 用虚构服务案例评估 Bubble 消息及文件共享、受控客户通话与决定副本保存。
use_cases.basis: Proposed workflow evaluation, not measured adoption or ROI.

Deployment.en: Public, Hybrid, HDS and custom Edge have different operating scopes; no universal self-host installation verified.
Deployment.zh: 公共、Hybrid、HDS 及定制 Edge 的运营范围不同，未核实通用自行托管安装。

specific_roles: Service team with business telephony requirements

steps.en: Choose the communication architecture and define who needs continuing Bubble access versus one conference.
steps.zh: 选择通信架构，确定谁需持续 Bubble 访问、谁仅参加一次会议。

steps.en: Validate a synthetic client call, admission, initiator handoff and an independently usable exit copy on the actual license.
steps.zh: 在实际许可上验证虚构客户通话、准入、发起者交接及可独立使用的退出副本。

sections.title_en: Start with the communication path your team needs
sections.title_zh: 先确定团队需要的通信路径
sections.en:
Consider a proposed service team discussing a customer issue in a Bubble, sharing a diagnostic file and escalating into a call. The Bubble keeps the conversation together; it is not itself a new telephone number or a replacement PBX. The current offers distinguish Hybrid services connected with local infrastructure, fully cloud-based Voice services and custom Rainbow Edge private deployment projects. Connectors, rooms, webinars and developer usage have separate commercial scopes.

List which calls must reach ordinary phone numbers, which can remain app-to-app and whether existing desk phones must participate. Then request the exact licensing, routing, country availability and carrier responsibilities for that architecture. A free collaboration account does not establish that public-network calling, emergency calling or an arbitrary PBX is included. No telephone system was configured or replaced.
sections.zh:
假设服务团队在 Bubble 讨论客户问题、共享诊断文件，再升级为通话。Bubble 汇集讨论，本身不提供新电话号码，也不等于替换 PBX。当前报价介绍区分连接本地基础设施的 Hybrid、完全云端的 Voice，以及定制 Rainbow Edge 私有部署项目。连接器、会议室、网络研讨会及开发者用量另有商业范围。

应列明哪些通话需到普通电话号码、哪些可限于应用之间，以及现有桌面电话是否必须参与；再取得该架构的精确许可、路由、国家可用性及运营商责任。免费协作账户不证明包含公网通话、紧急呼叫或任意 PBX。本研究未配置或替换电话系统。

sections.title_en: A project invitation grants more than a meeting seat
sections.title_zh: 项目邀请授予的访问超过一个会议席位
sections.en:
The creation guide makes the creator the Bubble owner and keeps invited members pending until they accept. It also offers an option to give every invitee an organizer role. For the service-team example, decide explicitly whether a customer is a continuing project member or only a temporary conference participant; promoting everyone is a permissions decision, not merely a convenience.

Organizers may share a Bubble link, while only its owner changes whether it is valid for everyone or existing members. A waiting room lets an organizer approve entry. The member guide says removing someone blocks further Bubble access without notifying them. The privacy notice separately warns that new participants can see prior conversation history. Inspect the existing files and messages before adding an external member, and do not assume removal erases copies already received.
sections.zh:
创建指南规定创建者自动成为 Bubble 所有者，受邀成员在接受前保持待定状态；还提供把所有受邀者设为组织者的选项。在服务团队示例中，应明确客户是持续项目成员，还是仅参加一次会议的临时参与者；把所有人提升为组织者是权限决定，不只是便利选项。

组织者可共享 Bubble 链接，但只有所有者能改变链接对所有人还是现有成员有效。等候室让组织者批准加入。成员指南称，移除成员会阻止其继续访问 Bubble，但不发移除通知。隐私通知另外提醒，新参与者可看见既有对话历史。增加外部成员前，应检查现有文件和消息，也不要假定移除会抹去已接收的副本。

sections.title_en: Bubble membership, call capacity and storage have different limits
sections.title_zh: Bubble 成员、通话人数及存储各有上限
sections.en:
The July 2026 matrix lists Essential with 50 Bubbles of 20 participants, Business with 200 of 100 and Enterprise with 500 of 300. Storage is 1 GB on Essential/Business and 20 GB on Enterprise. These are plan limits, not a promise that every Bubble member can join a video meeting simultaneously. Built-in calls are shown as one-to-one on the first two tiers and up to 120 participants on Enterprise; scheduled conferencing and recording also depend on the plan.

The older general conference guide says Business or Enterprise can start web conferencing, while the newer matrix distinguishes ad-hoc escalation from scheduled meetings. Preserve that distinction and validate the exact intended action on the purchased license. In the proposed project, size the persistent workspace and the live session separately. Being under the Bubble membership limit does not resolve a conference admission failure.
sections.zh:
2026年7月矩阵列出 Essential 可有50个 Bubble、每个20名参与者；Business 为200个、每个100人；Enterprise 为500个、每个300人。Essential／Business 存储为1GB，Enterprise 为20GB。这些套餐限制不保证全部 Bubble 成员能同时加入视频会议。前两级的内置通话列为一对一，Enterprise 最多120人；预定会议及录制也取决于套餐。

较旧的一般会议指南称 Business 或 Enterprise 可发起网络会议，较新矩阵则区分临时升级与预定会议。应保留此区别，并在所购许可上验证目标操作。在假设项目中，应分别估算持续工作区与实时会议容量；低于 Bubble 成员上限，并不能排除会议拒绝加入。

sections.title_en: Prepare admission and handoff before starting the call
sections.title_zh: 通话开始前安排准入及交接
sections.en:
The meeting guide distinguishes adding a permanent Bubble member from adding someone only to the current conference; temporary participants leave both when that conference ends. Locking a conference prevents further joins even for invitees. Only its initiator can end or delegate it, and the documented delegation target needs an Enterprise plan. Confirm a suitable successor before the initiator leaves a customer session.

The preparation guide says mute-on-entry still lets participants unmute themselves. It also provides an entry-tone setting and an optional start confirmation. Treat those as meeting behavior controls, not a compliance recording or consent mechanism. Test the actual desktop/mobile actions needed: several help tabs say coming soon. Recording location, participant consent, retention, transcript accuracy and download/recovery were not established and must be resolved before treating Rainbow as a call archive.
sections.zh:
会议指南区分添加永久 Bubble 成员与仅添加本次会议参与者；后者在会议结束时退出会议和 Bubble。锁定会议会阻止继续加入，即使对方已获邀请。只有发起者能结束或委托会议，文档要求接手者具有 Enterprise 套餐。发起者离开客户会议前，应确认合适的接手者。

准备指南说明，入场静音仍允许参与者自行取消静音；另有入场音和可选开始确认。这些是会议行为设置，不是合规录制或同意机制。应测试真正需要的桌面／移动端操作，一些帮助标签仍写 coming soon。录制位置、参与者同意、保留、转录准确率及下载恢复尚未确立；将 Rainbow 当作通话归档前应先解决。

sections.title_en: Price the license, renewal mode and optional services together
sections.title_zh: 一并核对许可、续订模式及可选服务
sections.en:
The actual current offer page advertises Essential as a limited free offer and directs customers to experts for license choices. Its trial FAQ limits the statement to some offers, naming Rainbow Hub and the Teams telephony connector. No current numerical Business/Enterprise tariff was verified; old 2/4 EUR training material and reseller tables are not adopted as a live price.

The subscription dashboard guide describes license quantities, monthly billing or prepaid 1/3/5-year terms, multiple subscriptions for a plan and several renewal modes. It is written for Business Partner Finance/Operations roles, not an ordinary member’s self-service checkout. For an editorial cost model, separate seats, PSTN usage/options, connectors, private-project work and any hardware or carrier charges. Obtain the specific order’s tax, cancellation, renewal and downgrade terms rather than inferring them from a per-user headline.
sections.zh:
实际当前报价页把 Essential 宣传为受限免费方案，并引导客户向专家确认许可选择。试用 FAQ 只说部分方案可试用，点名 Rainbow Hub 和 Teams 电话连接器。本次未核实当前 Business／Enterprise 数字价目，不采用旧培训资料的2／4欧元或经销商表格作为实时价格。

订阅仪表盘指南描述许可数量、按月或预付1／3／5年、同一套餐下多个订阅及多种续订方式。该指南面向 Business Partner 的 Finance／Operations 角色，不是普通成员自助结账。在编辑成本模型中，应分开计算席位、PSTN 用量／选项、连接器、私有项目工作，以及硬件或运营商费用。税、取消、续订和降级应取得具体订单条款，不能从每用户宣传推断。

sections.title_en: Check the client and service environment before diagnosing a call
sections.title_zh: 排查通话前核对客户端及服务环境
sections.en:
The prerequisites article applies to the public and HDS environments; Edge follows its own independently operated deployment policy. It lists cookies and JavaScript as requirements and documents Safari limitations, including screen/app sharing and in-app microphone/camera selection. A supported browser label therefore does not mean identical functionality. Test the exact device and browser chosen for the service team.

The article’s April 2026 table still contains an upcoming minimum-version change scheduled for May. It also states a current-plus-two-major-version policy. Those statements do not establish the effective minimum in October, so verify that value for rollout rather than copying the old table. For a join or media failure, inspect invitation acceptance, meeting lock/capacity, service entitlement, browser restrictions and network configuration in that order as a proposed diagnosis. No installation, live call or bandwidth assessment was run.
sections.zh:
前提文章适用于公共及 HDS 环境；Edge 遵循其独立部署政策。文章列出 cookies 和 JavaScript 要求，并说明 Safari 在屏幕／应用共享、应用内麦克风／摄像头选择方面的限制。因此，列为受支持浏览器不表示功能完全一致，应测试服务团队选用的具体设备和浏览器。

2026年4月表格仍包含计划于5月发生的最低版本变化，又声明支持当前及前两个主版本。这些内容不能确立10月实际最低版本，部署时应重新确认，不能照搬旧表。对于加入或媒体失败，可依次检查邀请接受、会议锁定／容量、服务许可、浏览器限制和网络配置；这是建议的排查路径。本研究未执行安装、实时通话或带宽测量。

sections.title_en: Resolve the service agreement and preservation needs
sections.title_zh: 明确服务协议及保存需求
sections.en:
The public terms grant limited use of the free service and reserve ALE’s intellectual property; they do not grant the service source or a self-hosting distribution. A company’s accepted service terms take precedence. Rainbow Edge is offered as a tailored private project, not proof of a downloadable open-source server. The free-service text also excludes emergency-number calling; obtain the relevant carrier and enterprise obligations for any telephony deployment.

The security brief describes shared responsibility: ALE operates infrastructure while customers control application access and privacy rules. Regional storage and provider backups are not a tested customer restore procedure. The Rainbow privacy notice distinguishes the organizational customer’s controller role from direct consumer registration, and uses purpose-based personal-data retention without a universal day count. For the proposed team, define who removes members, preserves necessary decisions and retrieves an exit copy. Exact contract-specific residency, backup recovery and full export remain unverified; no certification or compliance outcome was independently checked.
sections.zh:
公开条款授予免费服务的有限使用权，并保留 ALE 知识产权，不授予服务源代码或自行托管发行权。公司已接受的专属服务条款优先。Rainbow Edge 作为定制私有项目提供，不证明存在可下载的开源服务器。免费服务文本还排除紧急号码呼叫；电话部署应取得相关运营商及企业义务。

安全说明采用共享责任：ALE 运营基础设施，客户控制应用访问及隐私规则。区域存储和厂商备份不等于经过测试的客户恢复流程。Rainbow 隐私通知区分组织客户作为控制者与消费者直接注册的角色；个人数据按目的需要保留，没有统一天数。在假设团队中，应明确由谁移除成员、保存必要决定及取得退出副本。合同专属驻留、备份恢复及完整导出仍未核实；未独立核验任何认证或合规结果。

secondary_questions: Does Bubble membership equal conference capacity?
What remains accessible to a new Bubble member?
